name: Sichuan Jinshi Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Sichuan Jinshi Technology Co.,Ltd does not have significant operations. It intends to operate business through asset restructuring or new business expansion. Previously, the company was engaged in research and development, production, and sale of cigarette labels and packaging printed materials. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China. Sichuan Jinshi Technology Co.,Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Elegant Time Holdings Limited.
